tool_schemas.name: show_campaigns
tool_schemas.description: Lists campaigns visible to the authenticated user, optionally filtered by status and ordered by the requested sort field; returns a page of campaign records and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Results are cursor-paged using limit (1–100) and cursor, where omitting cursor starts from the first page. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when no valid session is provided, FORBIDDEN when the user is not permitted to list campaigns, and VALIDATION_ERROR when status/sort/order are not one of the supported values or limit/cursor are invalid.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_characters
tool_schemas.description: Lists character entities within the specified campaign, with optional filtering by status, parent_entity_id, and partial name match, and returns a cursor-paged result set. Results are cursor-paged using limit (1–100) and cursor, where omitting cursor starts from the first page and the response includes the next cursor when more results exist. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, FORBIDDEN when you lack access to the campaign, NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist (or is not visible to you) or when parent_entity_id does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs don’t match the required ULID formats or when limit/sort/order/status values are invalid.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID to list characters from.

parent_entity_id.description: Filter characters by parent entity ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of characters to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_character
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single character entity by its entity ULID and returns the full character record. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, NOT_FOUND when the character does not exist (or is not visible to you), and FORBIDDEN when you do not have permission to view the character in its campaign. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when character_id is not a valid character entity ULID.

tool_schemas.name: create_character
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new character in the given campaign and returns the created character record. Validates required fields (campaign_id, name) and optional attributes (title, type, age, sex, pronouns, race_id, entry_html, parent_entity_id, entity_image_uuid) and will only attach a parent_entity_id that exists and is accessible in the same campaign. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, FORBIDDEN when you cannot create characters in the campaign, NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist (or is not visible to you) or the specified parent_entity_id does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs are malformed, name is empty, or field types/values are invalid.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID to create the character in.

race_id.description: Kanka race ID associated with the character.

entity_image_uuid.description: Image UUID for the character entity.

tool_schemas.name: update_character
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing character in the specified campaign and returns the updated character record; only provided fields are changed, including status, is_destroyed, and hierarchy via parent_entity_id. The request is validated to ensure the character belongs to the provided campaign and that any parent_entity_id refers to an existing, accessible entity. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, FORBIDDEN when you cannot edit characters in the campaign, NOT_FOUND when the campaign or character does not exist (or is not visible to you), CONFLICT when the requested update is rejected due to an invalid state transition (for example, setting an unsupported status), and VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs are malformed or field values/types are invalid.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID the character belongs to.

type.description: Updated type/class label for the character.

race_id.description: Updated Kanka race ID associated with the character.

entry_html.description: Updated HTML entry/description for the character.

parent_entity_id.description: Updated parent entity ULID for hierarchy.

entity_image_uuid.description: Updated image UUID for the character entity.

tool_schemas.name: delete_character
tool_schemas.description: Deletes (removes) a character identified by character_id from the given campaign and returns a confirmation of deletion. The request is validated to ensure the character exists and belongs to the specified campaign. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, FORBIDDEN when you lack permission to delete characters in the campaign, NOT_FOUND when the campaign or character does not exist (or is not visible to you), and VALIDATION_ERROR when either ID is not in the expected ULID format.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID the character belongs to.

tool_schemas.name: list_locations
tool_schemas.description: Lists location entities within the specified campaign, optionally filtered by status, parent_entity_id, and partial name match, and returns a cursor-paged result set. Results are cursor-paged using limit (1–100) and cursor, where omitting cursor starts from the first page and the response includes the next cursor when more results exist. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, FORBIDDEN when you lack access to the campaign, NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist (or is not visible to you) or when parent_entity_id does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs don’t match the required ULID formats or when limit/sort/order/status values are invalid.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID to list locations from.

parent_entity_id.description: Filter locations by parent entity ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of locations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_location
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single location entity by its entity ULID and returns the full location record. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, NOT_FOUND when the location does not exist (or is not visible to you), and FORBIDDEN when you do not have permission to view the location in its campaign. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when location_id is not a valid location entity ULID.

tool_schemas.name: create_location
tool_schemas.description:
Creates a new location in the given campaign and returns the created location record; entry is stored as HTML and non-HTML input may be wrapped in

tags. If location_id is provided, it is used as the parent location to form a hierarchy, and any provided tag IDs are attached when they exist and are accessible in the same campaign. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, FORBIDDEN when you cannot create locations in the campaign, NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist (or is not visible to you) or when a referenced parent location/tag cannot be found, and VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs are malformed, name is empty, or field types/values are invalid.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign to create the location in.

entry.description:
Location description as HTML (non-HTML will be wrapped in

tags).

location_id.description: Parent location entity ID (creates a hierarchy).

tags.description: Array of tag IDs to attach to the location.

is_destroyed.description: Whether the location is marked as destroyed.

tool_schemas.name: update_location
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing location in the specified campaign and returns the updated location record; only provided fields are changed, including hierarchy and destroyed/status flags where supported. The request is validated to ensure the location belongs to the provided campaign and that any referenced parent location and tags exist and are accessible. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, FORBIDDEN when you cannot edit locations in the campaign, NOT_FOUND when the campaign or location does not exist (or is not visible to you), CONFLICT when the requested update is rejected due to an invalid state transition, and VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs are malformed or field values/types are invalid.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign containing the location.

location_id.description: ID of the location entity to update.

entry.description:
Updated location description as HTML (non-HTML will be wrapped in

tags).

tags.description: Array of tag IDs to set on the location.

is_destroyed.description: Whether the location is marked as destroyed.

tool_schemas.name: delete_location
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes the specified location entity from the given campaign and returns an empty success response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id/location_id are malformed, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have delete permission in the campaign, NOT_FOUND if the campaign doesn’t exist or the location doesn’t exist in that campaign (or isn’t visible to you), and CONFLICT if the location can’t be deleted due to campaign rules or entity state.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign containing the location.

location_id.description: ID of the location entity to delete.

tool_schemas.name: list_posts
tool_schemas.description: Lists posts belonging to the specified entity within a campaign and returns a page of post objects ordered by the requested sort; results are cursor-paginated with limit (1–100) and cursor, and the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, limit, sort, or status, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign/entity or don’t have permission to view posts, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign or entity doesn’t exist (or isn’t visible).

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign containing the entity.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity to list posts for (not a post ID).

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_post
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single post by post_id for the given entity in a campaign and returns the post object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id is malformed, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign/entity/post, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign, entity, or post doesn’t exist, or if the post_id is not a post belonging to the provided entity_id.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign containing the entity and post.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity the post belongs to (not a post ID).

post_id.description: ID of the post to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: create_post
tool_schemas.description:
Creates a new post on the specified entity within a campaign and returns the created post; name is required, entry is stored as HTML (non-HTML input is wrapped in

tags), and position/visibility_id are applied when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including malformed ids or empty name), FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to create posts on that entity in the campaign, NOT_FOUND if the campaign or entity doesn’t exist (or isn’t visible), and CONFLICT if the requested visibility_id is not allowed in the campaign or the entity is in a state that refuses new posts.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign containing the entity.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity this post belongs to.

entry.description:
Post content as HTML (non-HTML will be wrapped in

tags).

position.description: Position/order value used to order posts (e.g., pinned ordering).

visibility_id.description: Visibility setting identifier for the post.

tool_schemas.name: update_post
tool_schemas.description:
Updates an existing post for the specified entity and returns the updated post; provided fields are changed, and entry is stored as HTML (non-HTML input is wrapped in

tags). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids or invalid field values (including empty name), FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to edit the post, NOT_FOUND if the campaign, entity, or post doesn’t exist or if the post does not belong to the given entity_id, and CONFLICT if the update is refused due to campaign visibility rules or post/entity state.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign containing the entity and post.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity this post belongs to.

post_id.description: ID of the post to update.

entry.description:
Updated post content as HTML (non-HTML will be wrapped in

tags).

position.description: Updated position/order value used to order posts.

visibility_id.description: Updated visibility setting identifier for the post.

tool_schemas.name: delete_post
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes the specified post from the given entity and returns an empty success response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id is malformed, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to delete the post, NOT_FOUND if the campaign, entity, or post doesn’t exist or if the post_id does not belong to the provided entity_id, and CONFLICT if the post cannot be deleted due to campaign rules or entity/post state.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign containing the entity and post.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity the post belongs to (not a post ID).

post_id.description: ID of the post to delete.

tool_schemas.name: list_notes
tool_schemas.description: Lists notes in the specified campaign and returns a cursor-paginated page of note entities; use limit (1–100) and cursor to page, sort and order to control ordering, and include_deleted to include soft-deleted notes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed campaign_id or invalid paging/sort parameters, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign or permission to list notes, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign doesn’t exist (or isn’t visible).

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID to list notes from.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_note
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single note entity by note_id and returns the note object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if note_id is malformed, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to view the note, and NOT_FOUND if the note doesn’t exist or isn’t visible to you.

tool_schemas.name: create_note
tool_schemas.description:
Create a new note in a campaign. Fields: campaign_id: The ID of the campaign to add the note to name: The name of the note (required) entry: The note's entry/description (optional, must be HTML. If not HTML, it will be wrapped in

tags.) type: The note's type (optional) note_id: The parent note id (optional) tags: Array of tag ids (optional) entity_image_uuid: Gallery image UUID for the entity image (optional) entity_header_uuid: Gallery image UUID for the entity header (limited to premium campaigns) (optional) is_private: If the note is only visible to admin members (optional)

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID to create the note in.

entry.description:
HTML entry/description for the note; non-HTML will be wrapped in

tags.

type.description: Optional type label for the note.

note_id.description: Parent note entity ULID (creates a hierarchy).

tags.description: Array of tag ULIDs to assign to the note.

entity_image_uuid.description: Gallery image UUID for the note's entity image.

tool_schemas.name: update_note
tool_schemas.description:
Update an existing note. Fields: campaign_id: The ID of the campaign note_id: The ID of the note to update name: The name of the note (optional) entry: The note's entry/description (optional, must be HTML. If not HTML, it will be wrapped in

tags.) type: The note's type (optional) parent_note_id: The parent note id (optional) tags: Array of tag ids (optional) entity_image_uuid: Gallery image UUID for the entity image (optional) entity_header_uuid: Gallery image UUID for the entity header (limited to premium campaigns) (optional) is_private: If the note is only visible to admin members (optional)

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID the note belongs to.

entry.description:
Updated HTML entry/description; non-HTML will be wrapped in

tags.

type.description: Updated type label for the note.

tags.description: Array of tag ULIDs to set on the note.

entity_image_uuid.description: Updated gallery image UUID for the note's entity image.

tool_schemas.name: delete_note
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes the specified note from the given campaign and returns an empty success response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id/note_id are malformed, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have delete permission for notes in the campaign, NOT_FOUND if the campaign doesn’t exist or the note doesn’t exist in that campaign (or isn’t visible), and CONFLICT if the note can’t be deleted due to campaign rules or entity state.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID the note belongs to.

tool_schemas.name: list_journals
tool_schemas.description: Lists journals in the specified campaign and returns a cursor-paginated page of journal entities; use limit (1–100) and cursor to page, sort and order to control ordering (including by date), and include_deleted to include soft-deleted journals. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed campaign_id or invalid paging/sort parameters, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign or permission to list journals, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign doesn’t exist (or isn’t visible).

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID to list journals from.

limit.description: Maximum number of journals to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_journal
tool_schemas.description: Returns the journal entity identified by journal_id, including its stored fields (such as name, entry HTML, type, date, and any parent relationship) when you have access to the owning campaign. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if journal_id is not a valid journal ULID, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to view the journal’s campaign, and NOT_FOUND if no journal with that id exists or it isn’t visible to you.

tool_schemas.name: create_journal
tool_schemas.description:
Creates a new journal in the specified campaign and returns the created journal entity; entry is stored as HTML and non-HTML input may be wrapped in

tags, and journal_id (when provided) sets the parent journal to create a hierarchy. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including malformed ULIDs), if name is empty, or if provided parent/author identifiers are not acceptable; UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated; FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to create journals in the campaign; and NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist or the specified parent journal does not exist in that campaign.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID to create the journal in.

entry.description:
HTML entry/description for the journal; non-HTML will be wrapped in

tags.

type.description: Optional type label for the journal.

journal_id.description: Parent journal entity ULID (creates a hierarchy).

author_id.description: Optional Kanka author id for the journal entry.

tool_schemas.name: update_journal
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified journal in the given campaign and returns the updated journal entity, applying any provided fields (name, entry HTML, type, date, and parent_journal_id) and leaving unspecified fields unchanged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or if supplied field values are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to edit journals in the campaign, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign or journal does not exist (or the journal does not belong to the campaign) or if the specified parent journal cannot be found in the same campaign.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign that owns the journal (ULID).

journal_id.description: ID of the journal entity to update (ULID).

entry.description:
Updated journal entry/description as HTML (non-HTML may be wrapped in

tags).

date.description: Updated session date (freeform string as stored).

parent_journal_id.description: ID of the parent journal entity (ULID).

tool_schemas.name: delete_journal
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified journal from the given campaign and returns a successful deletion response when the journal exists and you have delete rights. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id or journal_id are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to delete journals in the campaign, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign or journal does not exist or the journal is not part of that campaign.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign that owns the journal (ULID).

journal_id.description: ID of the journal entity to delete (ULID).

tool_schemas.name: update_campaign
tool_schemas.description: Updates a campaign’s mutable fields and lifecycle status and returns the updated campaign record. Only provided fields are changed (patch semantics). Supports transitioning status between active and archived, and soft-deleting by setting status=deleted; refuses invalid transitions (e.g., deleted -> active) and refuses updates when you lack permission for the campaign. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED when not signed in, NOT_FOUND when the campaign doesn’t exist (or is deleted/inaccessible), FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access, and VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid input.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ULID to update.

description.description: Campaign description (HTML or plain text as stored).

status.description: Lifecycle status transition for the campaign.

metadata.name: Kanka API Server
metadata.description: This backend stores worldbuilding content for Kanka campaigns and exposes CRUD APIs for core entity types (characters, locations, notes, journals) plus entity posts. The main workflow is: an authenticated user selects a campaign, creates/updates entities within that campaign, optionally assigns tags
